extract: crawl mode follows linked pages

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"max_depth\":1,\"max_pages\":4,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{}},\"mode\":\"crawl\"}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.summary.pagesCrawled)
    println(result.results.get(1).content)
}
```
